scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:server: ORBITAL_PORT=4838 ORBITAL_DEV_TOOLS=1 ORBITAL_DATA_DIR="$HOME/Library/Application Support/orbital-dev" npm run dev -w server
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run dist:local -w desktop
scripts.desktop:build:self: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run dist:self -w desktop
scripts.desktop:release: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run dist -w desktop
scripts.android:release: env -u ORBITAL_MOBILE_DEV npm run build -w @orbital/mobile && npm run play -w @orbital/mobile
scripts.android:bundle: env -u ORBITAL_MOBILE_DEV npm run build -w @orbital/mobile && npm run aab -w @orbital/mobile
scripts.ios:release: env -u ORBITAL_MOBILE_DEV npm run build:ios -w @orbital/mobile && npm run ipa -w @orbital/mobile
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && npm test -w server && npm run test:run -w web && npm test -w desktop && npm test -w relay
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w desktop && npm run typecheck -w relay && npm run typecheck -w mobile
